items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: You know where the Wogan's live?

ctx.x: And things were going on just as nice and nobody. My mother came in here and we lived on Priya. Priya, the Wogan's. You know where the Wogan's live? On Priya and Espinade? Those are very old, rich people. On Espinade and Priya. And my mother came here and I don't know how it came with the neighbors and all. They told the Wogan's that my mother was a modi. So, she starts running right away. Being a neighbor, she went to see. Then they sent it to different ones and all. Then I was 14 when my father died. We moved…
